groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on food and drink at home, €362 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 1.00 USD for each euro spent in Finland, including the metro-area price level.
groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation.

eatingOut.basis: Average spending in Finland on eating out and hotels, €196 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 0.94 USD for each euro spent in Finland, including the metro-area price level.
eatingOut.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation.

recreation.basis: Average spending in Finland on leisure and holidays, €251 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 0.96 USD for each euro spent in Finland, including the metro-area price level.
recreation.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation.

clothing.basis: Average spending in Finland on clothes and shoes, €111 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 0.91 USD for each euro spent in Finland, including the metro-area price level.
clothing.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation.

communicationsPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on phone and internet (services and devices), €70 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 2.12 USD for each euro spent in Finland, including the metro-area price level.
communicationsPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation.

transitPassAdult.basis: CapMetro calendar-month pass for local and rapid buses; fares rise on 10 January 2027.

healthcarePerPerson.basis: Employer health plan: the average worker share of a single-coverage premium ($1,440 a year, KFF 2025) plus out-of-pocket spending per person ($556.6 billion in 2024, CMS, over 340.0 million people).
healthcarePerPerson.limitations: Assumes an employer plan. Without one, marketplace premiums are much higher; family coverage costs the worker about $6,850 a year.

childcarePerChild.basis: Average price of centre-based infant care in Texas ($11,349 a year; toddlers $10,921), Child Care Aware of America.
childcarePerChild.limitations: A Texas average; Austin prices are likely higher.

carMonthly.basis: Average cost of owning and running a new car in the US, including depreciation, finance, fuel and insurance, at 15,000 miles a year (AAA Your Driving Costs 2025).
carMonthly.limitations: A new-car national average; an older car costs less.
